entries.005e03ef93357b30: A reportable segment that includes investment in and support for the development of venture companies and others, the fund business that forms, manages, and operates investment partnerships, the PIPEs business that underwrites private placements by listed companies, and the investment banking business that provides corporate finance services for needs accompanying the businesses. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥497 million and there was a segment loss of ¥422 million, compared with a segment profit of ¥502 million in the previous fiscal year (the fiscal year ended March 2025). The securities report cites the fact that no new investment partnership was formed and that the share prices of listed companies invested in fell, among other things, as the reasons for the results. Note that the securities report lists four business areas for the group as a whole: the self-investment business, the fund business, the PIPEs business, and the investment banking business; of these, it states that three—fund, PIPEs, and investment banking—are included in this segment.

entries.eb9ca86c08a661c7: For the fiscal year ended March 2026, operating loss was ¥1,387 million (operating profit of ¥1,427 million in the previous year), loss before income taxes was ¥1,395 million, and net loss for the period was ¥1,245 million (net profit of ¥1,243 million in the previous year). Loss attributable to owners of the parent for the period was ¥1,231 million. The annual securities report cites as reasons for the Financial Solutions Business's operating loss of ¥422 million that no new investment partnerships were formed and that the share prices of listed investee companies fell, and it also cites impairment losses of ¥279 million (mainly goodwill relating to consolidated subsidiaries with continuing operating losses) as a main factor in cash flows from operating activities. The operating profit of the previous year included a gain on sale of shares of ReYuu Japan Co., Ltd. of ¥896 million. Total assets at the end of the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥18,632 million (¥7,629 million at the end of the previous year), and short-term and long-term borrowings increased by ¥7,836 million.
